CFILTER.stands_in_for: the input filter at the top of its tolerance, which is the slowest, with no dielectric loss and no DC bias derating

CPIN.stands_in_for: the controller pin's own capacitance at the datasheet's typical, which is the only figure it states

FIELD.stands_in_for: a field signal at the bottom of the declared supply range, as an ideal source with no series resistance of its own; a real field driver is slower and the wiring adds resistance

RLOWER.stands_in_for: the lower divider element at the bottom of its tolerance, which lowers the level the pin reaches

RSERIES.stands_in_for: the series element that bounds injection, at the top of its tolerance

RUPPER.stands_in_for: the upper divider element at the top of its tolerance, which charges the filter slowest

description: one field input driven from the bottom of the declared supply range, through the divider, the filter and the series element that feeds the controller pin
name: field_input_edge_through_its_divider_and_filter
